summary.es: La caida sigue, pero mas calmada: ETH baja 5.25% en 24 horas (antes 7.04%) y BTC 3.72% (antes 5.09%), la ventana de 24 horas ya rodo mas allá de lo peor del desplome electoral. NQ y ES ya rebotaron con fuerza en la apertura de NY (NQ +2.4% y ES +1.0% desde la apertura del dia, cambio de caracter al alza en ambos), pero ETH y BTC no acompanan ese rebote todavia: divergencia real entre indices y cripto esta mañana. La nomina no agricola de EE. UU. ya salio a las 13:30 UTC con reaccion minima, asi que esa ventana de riesgo ya cerro. En BTC la zona de compra por barrida que se veia en vivo en el close termino rompiendose de verdad: el precio perforo su propio stop (75,950) hasta un minimo del dia en 75,304 antes de recuperar a 75,741; el checklist de tendencia tambien se reforzo de corto reducido a corto confirmado de tamano normal, asi que esa compra nunca iba a ser GO y ahora queda invalidada. En ETH el precio sigue bajando poco a poco hacia la zona real de compra en 2,203 a 2,210 (ya a unos 27 puntos, antes 36), todavia sin estar a tiro. El contexto sigue cargado: los hackeos de Binance siguen dentro de su ventana de 24 horas (quedan unas 7 horas), se suman salidas de mas de 500 millones de dolares en ETFs cripto en las ultimas horas, y mi historial de zonas en contexto de miedo y con titular de hackeo activo se mantiene bajo 40%: la conviccion se queda baja en las dos monedas.
summary.en: The slide is still running, just calmer: ETH is down 5.25% in 24 hours (was 7.04%) and BTC 3.72% (was 5.09%), as the 24 hour window has now rolled past the worst of the election selloff. NQ and ES already bounced hard at the NY cash open (NQ +2.4% and ES +1.0% from the day open, a change of character to the upside in both), but ETH and BTC are not following that bounce yet: a real divergence between the indices and crypto this morning. The US jobs report already came out at 13:30 UTC with minimal reaction, so that risk window has closed. On BTC the buy zone from the live sweep seen at the close actually broke for real: price punched through its own stop (75,950) down to a daily low of 75,304 before recovering to 75,741; the trend checklist also strengthened from reduced size short to confirmed normal size short, so that buy was never going to be a go and is now invalidated. On ETH price keeps grinding lower toward the real buy zone at 2,203 to 2,210 (now about 27 points away, was 36), still not in reach. Context stays loaded: the Binance hacks are still inside their 24 hour window (about 7 hours left), more than $500 million in crypto ETF outflows add to it in the last few hours, and my track record for zones in a fear context with an active hack headline stays under 40%: conviction stays low on both coins.

On ETH the shorts-crowded funding adds the exception point to the buy zone, but that context is also underperforming for now (4 of 14, 29%).
